scope: iid Uniform[0,1] in four original coordinates; A_tau=I_4-(1-tau)J_4/4 with arbitrary real tau, spectrum {1,1,1,tau}.
statement: Writing R=X^T(I-J/4)X and Y=(sum X_i)/2, the joint section satisfies integral_0^2 ||p_(R,Y)(.,y)||_infinity dy <=4*pi, hence ||p_(R+tau Y^2)||_infinity <=4*pi for every real tau. For tau!=0 the same 4*pi bound is the unnormalized scalar-Qrest mixed norm after b=tau y^2.
proof_key: For F=(S,R), S=sum X_i, grad S perpendicular grad R and J_2F=4 sqrt(R). The fiber {S=s,R=q} lies in a full 2-sphere of area 4*pi*q, giving p_(S,R)(s,q)<=pi sqrt(q). On the unit cube R<=1; changing S to Y=S/2 gives section cap 2*pi over y in [0,2].
not_claimed: No arbitrary-cap-one-law theorem and no full QFORM solution; continuity is not claimed from this argument.
